libwdi -- vendored static library (Windows driver installation)
=================================================================

Source: https://github.com/pbatard/libwdi (commit at the time of this build:
see `git log -1` in the upstream repo history around 2026-08; built from a
shallow clone, exact commit not pinned here -- see "Rebuilding" below).

License: LGPL-2.1-or-later (COPYING-LGPL, alongside this file). libwdi is
used here as a linked static library, unmodified in its licensing terms;
this project (GPL-3.0-or-later) links against it, which is permitted under
LGPL's linking exception.

What's vendored: `include/libwdi.h` + `lib/libwdi.lib` (x64, Release,
/MT static CRT to match this project's Release runtime setting). No
source is committed here -- only the library, matching this repo's existing
`third_party/libusb` vendoring pattern.

Build customizations made for this project (all x64-only, no WDK required):
- `msvc/config.h`: WinUSB embedding (WDK_DIR) and libusb0 embedding
  (LIBUSB0_DIR) left undefined -- this project only ever installs libusbK,
  never WinUSB or plain libusb0. OPT_M32/OPT_ARM disabled (x64 only, matches
  windows/installer/PhoneCam.iss's ArchitecturesAllowed=x64compatible).
  WDF_VER kept at 1011 (KMDF 1.11) -- used at runtime to fill the generated
  INF's KMDF-version fields even with no WdfCoInstaller redistributable
  embedded, since KMDF 1.11 has been inbox on Windows 10 1607+ and this
  project already requires Windows 11-era Media Foundation APIs elsewhere.
- `libwdi/embedder_files.h`: dropped the LIBUSBK_DIR\sys\amd64\WdfCoInstaller
  entry for the same inbox-KMDF reason above.
- `libwdi/.msvc/libwdi_static.vcxproj`: removed the `installer_arm64.vcxproj`
  ProjectReference (this project doesn't ship ARM64, and the ARM64 v143
  build tools aren't installed on the dev machine this was built on; unlike
  the x86/x64 references, upstream's arm64 one was missing
  `ReferenceOutputAssembly=false`, which made its build failure block this
  project even though nothing here needs its output). Also fixed a
  pre-existing upstream PreBuildEvent bug where `embedder embedded.h` was
  invoked as a bare command name instead of a path, which failed to resolve
  on this machine (exit 9009) -- changed to
  `"$(ProjectDir)\..\embedder.exe" embedded.h`.

Driver binaries embedded (libusbK.sys/.dll, libusb0.dll -- the actual
driver payload libwdi bundles and installs): sourced from
`third_party/libusbk-redist/` in this repo, NOT downloaded fresh -- see
that directory's own NOTICE.txt for where those came from.

Rebuilding: clone https://github.com/pbatard/libwdi, apply the four
customizations above, ensure `third_party/libusbk-redist/` is populated,
then build `libwdi/.msvc/libwdi_static.vcxproj` (or the `libwdi (static)`
target in `libwdi.sln`) for Release|x64 via MSBuild. Copy the resulting
`libwdi.lib` and `libwdi/libwdi.h` here.
